location_name: Assembly west/south of Caen (Epsom front; point = Cheux)
composing_units: 9th SS Panzer Division Hohenstaufen; 10th SS Panzer Division Frundsberg; (2nd SS Kampfgruppe Weidinger attached 29 June)
current_activity: ordered to assist; assembling west of Caen
notes: Rommel ordered the corps to assist on the evening of 26 June after Epsom began; its own planned counter-offensive toward Bayeux was pre-empted; piecemeal commitment; corps could not attack until the afternoon of 29 June.

commander: SS-Obergruppenführer Paul Hausser (until morning of 29 June); SS-Obergruppenführer Willi Bittrich to succeed
current_activity: changing commanders; unable to counterattack before 29 June
notes: Bittrich replaced Hausser as corps commander (effective morning 29 June); Hausser told Dollmann no counter-attack possible before 29 June.

location_name: West flank of the Odon salient (Grainville-sur-Odon / Le Valtru)
current_activity: counterattacking west flank of British salient
notes: Counter-attack by 9th and 10th SS Panzer Divisions on the west flank of the British salient began afternoon of 29 June and was largely spent by nightfall; night attack 29-30 June on Grainville and Le Valtru failed.
